ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Channel knickpoint density ratio knick_n / (chan_n + 1), 6-azimuth strike-coherent Radon knickpoint-chain line integral R6(knick_ratio * log1p(chi_step_max)), and cross-fault footwall-to-hanging-wall uplift boundary gradient |grad G_sigma(raised_n / (valid_n + 1))| at sigma in {1.5, 4.0} px.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Alluvial-fan sheetflood aggradation erases <1.5 m inter-channel scarps within centuries and 24.6% of Nevada lacks 1 m LiDAR, causing aerial-photo mappers to miss active piedmont faults; however, every ephemeral drainage crossing an active normal fault retains a steepened k_sn reach, aligned channel knickpoint chain (knick_n), and abrupt drop from uplifted footwall channels (raised_n > 0) into subsiding basin channels (raised_n = 0).
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Resistant welded-tuff / basalt caprock ledges and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (1332 m) / Bonneville (1463, 1552 m) wave-cut shorelines — separated via contour-variance shoreline rejection and downdip basement/gravity deepening.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_prior_lanes: First lane in GEMSDOE77 to ingest dem10_chi_100m_u8.tif (knick_n, raised_n, chan_n) and construct cross-drainage knickpoint chains and footwall chi-uplift transition gradients.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Rank 1 — High expected HOLDOUT-DTI gain across 100% of Nevada (especially the 24.6% LiDAR gap and alluvial fans), Low CPU cost (~6 s).
